sv.title: Köpläge efter chockvändningen
sv.summary: Fredagens börspanik byttes mot total eufori i måndags. En sådan tvärvändning brukar betyda köpläge.

en.title: Buying opportunity after the sharp reversal
en.summary: Friday's stock market panic gave way to total euphoria on Monday. Such a sharp turnaround usually signals a buying opportunity.
